stories.summary: ABB has signed a service agreement to modernize industrial drives at ACC's Jamul cement plant in Chhattisgarh. The company claims the project will improve operational reliability and avoid 16 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions without disrupting production. The work involves reconditioning 25 drives at the facility.

stories.title: ABB deploys advanced process control at Srinagar cement plant
stories.summary: ABB has implemented its Ability Expert Optimizer technology at TCI MAX Cement’s Srinagar facility. The company states the deployment is the region's first implementation of advanced process control in cement manufacturing. The project aims to improve clinker quality and energy efficiency through increased process stability.

stories.title: Duchy of Cornwall and Hemspan build BIOHAUS home
stories.summary: The Duchy of Cornwall has partnered with HEMSPAN to build the UK's first BIOHAUS home, using hemp insulation and timber framing to reduce construction emissions. The project aims to help the Duchy understand how natural materials support its ambition to become net zero by 2032.

stories.summary: Meta has signed purchase commitments for low-carbon cement, steel, and recycled plastics. The company says the deal will support its first commercial-scale facility.

stories.title: Datecrete turns date pits into building material
stories.summary: Datecrete, a material studio, is turning discarded date pits into tiles, furniture, and panels. The project won the designboom Special Prize at the Seoul Design Award 2026. The team says the material turns a local waste stream into a raw product. The pits are currently thrown away.

stories.title: UK housing market stalls as mortgage rates rise
stories.summary: The UK housing market is showing signs of weakness as rising mortgage rates hit buyer demand. October data from RICS showed new buyer enquiries falling to a net balance of -24 percent, while agreed sales dropped to -24 percent. The autumn selling season has stalled.

stories.title: New Zealand housing sales slump in October
stories.summary: Residential property sales in New Zealand fell 23.5 percent year-on-year in October, according to the Real Estate Institute of New Zealand. Sales were down 2 percent compared to September. October is typically a month when sales pick up as the market heads into the summer selling season.

stories.title: Hungary housing market cools as price growth slows
stories.summary: Hungary's housing market is cooling, with annual price growth slowing to 6.9 percent nationally. In Budapest, annual growth fell to 1.8 percent, the weakest increase since December 2023. Rents have recorded their sharpest monthly decline in almost six years, according to property portal ingatlan.com.

stories.title: M&G Real Estate acquires Amsterdam residential campus
stories.summary: M&G Real Estate has acquired the OurDomain Amsterdam Southeast residential and student housing campus for approximately 340 million euros. The property consists of 1,559 rental units across three buildings. The acquisition was made on behalf of the M&G European Property Fund.

stories.title: IOIPG REIT lowers IPO price to 91 sen
stories.summary: IOIPG REIT has trimmed its IPO price to 91 sen per share from 96 sen following institutional bookbuilding. The trust will refund five sen to successful retail applicants. The offering secured interest from government-linked investment companies and insurers despite what the firm described as market uncertainties.
